About IEOR

Industrial Engineering and Operations Research at IIT Bombay: our work, community and history.

The department

Models meet the world.

IEOR combines theory, modelling and application with a systems view of engineering and operations. Its programs, research, sponsored projects, consulting and continuing education connect methods with decisions in transportation, manufacturing, services and more.

Explore research
1976–2026

Our journey

Established as an interdisciplinary program in 1976, IEOR marked fifty years in 2026. The department's history includes Professor P. G. Awate's reminiscences and a decade-wise account of its development.

Read the full history

Golden Jubilee

The Golden Jubilee celebrations were inaugurated in September 2026, bringing the community together for a year of events and reflection.
